// Navigator build: 2026-10-15.7 (preserves installed manifest identity).
export const VIEW_TYPE = "local-search-sidebar";

// 保留已发布的侧栏 view type
export const TAB_VIEW_TYPE = "local-search-tab";
export const RESULT_WINDOW_MOUNT_MAX = 64;
export const RESULT_WINDOW_BUFFER_MIN = 6;
export const RESULT_ROW_HEIGHT_ESTIMATE = 112;

// 这些 Token 会改变结果卡真实高度。Style Settings 修改后，当前挂载行的
// ResizeObserver 会检测 signature 变化并一次性推进 geometryRevision。
export const RESULT_GEOMETRY_CSS_TOKENS = Object.freeze([
    "--ls-result-card-pad-x",
    "--ls-item-pad-y",
    "--ls-result-title-gap",
    "--ls-result-type-icon-size",
    "--ls-selection-action-size",
    "--ls-item-title-size",
    "--ls-result-snippet-margin-top",
    "--ls-item-snippet-size",
    "--ls-item-meta-size",
    "--ls-item-path-size",
    "--ls-result-meta-margin-top",
    "--ls-result-meta-pad-y",
    "--ls-result-meta-cell-height",
    "--ls-result-meta-icon-size",
    "--ls-meta-group-gap",
    "--ls-meta-group-max"
]);

// V11 adds an optional host file navigator; file data and search state remain owned by GLS.
export const EXTERNAL_SEARCH_API_VERSION = 18;

export const EXTERNAL_SEARCH_API_CAPABILITIES = Object.freeze([
    "isolated-session",
    "filters",
    "allowed-paths",
    "single-pick",
    "multi-select",
    "browse-then-batch",
    "batch-title-open",
    "inline-host",
    "recent-opened-readonly",
    "virtual-properties-readonly",
    "folder-picker",
    "folder-exclusion-picker",
    "property-editor",
    "shared-mobile-frame",
    "file-move",
    "embedded-create-context",
    "native-batch-selection",
    "property-catalog-readonly",
    "embedded-session-state",
    "host-file-navigation",
    "workbench-presentation", "workbench-toolbar", "project-catalog"
]);
export const SORT_FIELD_IDS = Object.freeze(Object.keys(SORT_FIELD_DEFS));

export const DEFAULT_SORT_FIELD_ORDER = Object.freeze([
    "relevance",
    "opened",
    "created",
    "contentModified",
    "fileModified",
    "name"
]);
export const CONTENT_TIME_CACHE_VERSION = 3;

// V265：创建/正文/文件修改的最终值一起持久化；仍读 V1/V2。
export const GLS_METADATA_DEFAULT_DIRECTORY = "GLS-元数据";
export const GLS_METADATA_HISTORY_VERSION = 1;
export const INDEX_CACHE_VERSION = 22;
export const RESULT_VIEW_IDS = ["detailed", "standard", "compact"];
export const RESULT_CONTENT_IDS = RESULT_CONTENT_DEFS.map(def => def.id);
export const RESULT_CONTENT_DEF_MAP = new Map(RESULT_CONTENT_DEFS.map(def => [def.id, def]));

export const VIEW_COMPOSER_SECTION_IDS = Object.freeze([
    "view",
    "snippet",
    "content",
    "sort",
    "filterPools",
    "sidebar",
    "toolbars",
    "exclusion"
]);

export const DEFAULT_RESULT_VIEWS = {
    detailed: {
        snippetLines: 3,
        showTags: true,
        showProperties: true,
        showFolder: true,
        showContentModifiedTime: true,
        showModifiedTime: false,
        showCreatedTime: true,
        contentOrder: [...RESULT_CONTENT_IDS]
    },
    standard: {
        snippetLines: 2,
        showTags: true,
        showProperties: true,
        showFolder: true,
        showContentModifiedTime: true,
        showModifiedTime: false,
        showCreatedTime: false,
        contentOrder: [...RESULT_CONTENT_IDS]
    },
    compact: {
        snippetLines: 0,
        showTags: false,
        showProperties: false,
        showFolder: true,
        showContentModifiedTime: true,
        showModifiedTime: false,
        showCreatedTime: false,
        contentOrder: [...RESULT_CONTENT_IDS]
    }
};

// 固定属性入口仅是 Filter Pool 属性键配置的展示位置；筛选由 FilterState 独占。
export const PROPERTY_SHORTCUT_DEFAULT_ICON = "list-filter";

export const NAVIGATOR_TOOLBAR_ACTIONS = Object.freeze({
    collapse: { label: "折叠 / 展开导航", icon: "chevrons-down-up" },
    results: { label: "查看结果", icon: "eye" },
    history: { label: "搜索历史", icon: "history" },
    create: { label: "创建 / 退出创建", icon: "file-plus" },
    "sort-navigation": { label: "侧栏工具", icon: "list-tree" },
    search: { label: "显示 / 收起搜索框", icon: "search" },
    filters: { label: "返回筛选导航", icon: "list-filter" },
    sort: { label: "结果排序", icon: "arrow-down-wide-narrow" },
    view: { label: "视图设置", icon: "sliders-horizontal" },
    time: { label: "时间范围", icon: "calendar-range" },
    "filter-pools": { label: "筛选池设置", icon: "list-filter" },
    batch: { label: "批量操作", icon: "list-checks" }
});

export const DEFAULT_SETTINGS = {
    keepSearchResultsInMemory: true,
    enableTabFocusSearch: true, // Tab 快速聚焦并全选搜索框
    focusSearchOnMobileOpen: false, // 移动端打开搜索界面时是否自动聚焦搜索框
    confirmBeforeDelete: true, // 删除文件前显示插件确认；弹窗“不再询问”可关闭，设置页可重新开启
    createLastType: "md", // 旧设置兼容字段；新建不再读取跨会话类型历史
    createMetadataMemory: {
        md: { folder: "01-零散笔记", tags: [], properties: [], template: { enabled: false, path: "" } },
        canvas: { folder: "01-零散笔记", tags: [], properties: [], template: { enabled: false, path: "" } },
        excalidraw: { folder: "01-零散笔记", tags: [], properties: [], template: { enabled: false, path: "" } }
    }, // 保留旧设置以兼容导入/路径维护；新建仅消费当前条件和当前 CreateDraft
    ioConcurrentLimit: 16,
    createSessionRecovery: {}, // 仅在提交 / 关闭时保存未完成创建；沿用 settings 唯一写链
    snippetReadLimit: 5000,
    snippetMaxLen: 200,          // 摘要最大字符数
    activeResultView: "standard", // 当前结果视图：详细 / 标准 / 精简
    resultViews: normalizeResultViews(DEFAULT_RESULT_VIEWS),
    filterPools: [], // 四类筛选池固定存在；旧数据缺失项规范化为 visible:false
    contentSegmentMaxLen: 8000,  // 正文索引最大读取字符，超长截断
    favoriteTemplatePaths: [],       // 模板 Picker 收藏路径；仅影响显示置顶，不改变 CreateDraft 选择
    excludedFolders: [],       // 全局排除文件夹：由结果视图设置管理，不参与索引和搜索
    resultExcludedFolders: [], // 结果排除文件夹：由顶部文件夹 Picker 管理，仍参与索引与操作，仅从结果/Facet 隐藏
    resultExcludedAttachmentTypes: [], // 附件扩展名的结果排除；不退出索引，附件 Picker 可恢复
    excludedKeys: [],          // 排除属性键列表（批量修改属性值的键列表里不显示）
    hiddenResultPropertyKeys: [], // 结果卡片不显示的属性；默认显示全部可用属性
    resultFolderColors: {},   // 结果卡文件夹颜色：{ "folder/path": { light, dark } }
    searchHistory: [],         // 最近搜索（最多20条，新的在前）
    favoriteSearches: [],       // 收藏搜索（用户主动管理）
    recentOpened: [],          // V237 历史兼容镜像；V238 以元数据目录中的设备独立记录为优先源
    metadataDirectory: GLS_METADATA_DEFAULT_DIRECTORY, // NAS 同步的仓库内目录，不能是 .obsidian / 仓库外绝对路径
    modalFilterSnapshot: null, // 除系统 X 外保存的筛选状态
    modalSearchQuery: "",      // 与当前搜索视图一起保存；仅系统 X 关闭时清空
    modalSortField: "opened",      // 当前搜索会话排序字段
    modalSortDirection: "desc",  // 排序方向：desc / asc
    modalViewportAnchor: null, // 搜索主窗恢复锚点：path + 视口偏移；scrollTop 只作最终 fallback
    resultSortOrder: [...DEFAULT_SORT_FIELD_ORDER], // 排序按钮循环顺序；由结果视图统一编排
    hiddenResultSortFields: ["fileModified"], // eye 关闭 = 不加入快捷循环；全量排序 Picker 仍可直接选择
    navigatorToolbars: normalizeNavigatorToolbars(null), // 移动侧栏按页面记忆底栏顺序、显隐与图标
    recentIconIds: [], // 所有图标选择入口共用，最近使用在前（最多24个）
    navigatorVisibleSections: normalizeNavigatorVisibleSections(null), // 视图设置拥有侧栏分组显隐
    navigatorTimeField: "created", // 固定日期区间共用排序组件的时间依据
    navigatorCustomization: {}, // 仅存导航外观、分隔线与分组顺序；文件/标签/属性排序沿用 Picker 权威源
    pickerFolderOrder: [],       // 文件夹 Picker 同级自定义顺序；层级变化仍写回真实 Vault
    pickerTagOrder: [],          // 标签 Picker 同级自定义顺序；层级变化仍写回真实 Markdown 标签
    pickerPropertyOrder: [],     // 属性键统一显示顺序；由属性 Picker 拖拽维护，不重排已有 Frontmatter
    pickerPropertyValueOrder: {}, // 属性值统一显示顺序；由属性 Picker 拖拽维护：{ key: [propertyValueKey...] }
    propertyValueCatalog: [], // 用户明确新增、尚未被文件使用的可选属性值；不复制文件索引
    modalBoundsV3: null         // 桌面窗口几何 { x, y, width, height }
};

// 文件物理后缀只由创建 / 重命名写链决定，Excalidraw 的真实类型仍以绘图 YAML 标记为准。
export const EXCALIDRAW_DRAWING_SUFFIX = "_绘图";

export const LZ_BASE64_ALPHABET =
    "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/=";
export const EMPTY_PROPERTY_VALUE = "␟__LS_EMPTY_PROPERTY_VALUE__␟";
export const PRESENT_PROPERTY_VALUE = "␟__LS_PRESENT_PROPERTY_VALUE__␟";
export const CREATE_TYPE_IDS = Object.freeze(["md", "canvas", "excalidraw"]);
export const NO_FRONTMATTER_WRITE = Symbol("local-search-no-frontmatter-write");

// ========== Result Swipe：结果卡左右滑动唯一状态机 ==========
export const RESULT_SWIPE_INTENT_SLOP_PX = 4;
export const RESULT_SWIPE_HORIZONTAL_BIAS = 1.15;
export const RESULT_SWIPE_SETTLE_RATIO = .35;
export const RESULT_SWIPE_SETTLE_MAX_PX = 56;

export const SEARCH_SELECTION_UI_REF_KEYS = Object.freeze("toolbar normalPanel batchPanel batchEntryBtn batchSelectToggleBtn expandActionsBtn externalSubmitBtn tagMetadataBtn propertyMetadataBtn moveFilesBtn deleteFilesBtn exitBatchBtn normalCurrentEl normalTotalEl batchSelectedEl batchResultEl".split(" "));

// ========== SearchCore：原生工作区 / Modal / 浮窗共用主体 ==========
export const SEARCH_CORE_UI_REF_KEYS = Object.freeze("searchInput resultsShell resultsContainer resultsRail typeButtonEls folderBtn clearFiltersBtn filterPoolHost filterPoolValues filterPoolShortcuts propertyFilterRow resultChannelHost activeFilterWrap".split(" "));

// END SHARED SETTINGS

export const SearchSettingRow = createPluginSettingClass(Setting);
